description: Read a Monnet idea's full details — summary, body, status, priority, plan steps with assignees, member roles, threaded comments (each comment shows a short id usable as parent_id in the comment tool to reply in its thread), your own private 1:1 conversation with Monnet on it (never anybody else's), and the files attached to it, each with the id read_idea_file takes. Call this when the user references a specific idea by its short id or URL. It also reads a thread, whose whole content is that private conversation.

idea_short_id.description: The first 8 characters of the idea UUID, visible in the idea URL.

workspace_slug.description: The workspace slug from the idea URL (e.g. 'monnet-team-410b'). Found in the path /<slug>/ideas/<short_id>.

name: get_idea
